supersedes: 1.0 (cream / teal / gold), archived as tokens-v1.json and tokens-v1.css
note: ADOPTED by Ryan on 2026-08-19. Vector is Serhant's white-plus-true-black surface structure carrying Tom Ferry's electric blue as the single accent. Pop comes twice: structurally from full-bleed black against white, and chromatically from the blue. Every pair below is WCAG 2.1 computed, not eyeballed. Minimum pair is 4.76.
evidence: bg-inv #000000 is Serhant's measured surface. accent #1768E5 is Tom Ferry's measured CTA blue. ink #050E3D is Real Broker's measured near-black. ink-2-inv and structure are derived. See PEDIGREE-BRAND-RESEARCH.md.

bg-2.role: sunken fill, table rows, inset panels. Faint cool cast

bg-inv.role: inverted surface, TRUE black. A surface, never text

line.role: hairline and divider on bg, non-text

structure.role: deep blue. Chart bars, structural fills, large headings

ink-2.role: secondary text on bg and bg-2

accent-txt.role: accent used AS text on bg

accent-inv.role: accent used AS text on bg-inv

type.note: Settled 2026-08-19 as pairing P08 from v4-fonts.html, with the headline weight confirmed against the 600 to 900 ladder in v4-weights.html. Three faces, three roles, no overlap.

head.role: headlines and thumbnail titles. Same weight in both, no page/thumbnail split

subtext.role: eyebrow, subhead, small label ONLY. 15px and up, one short line. NEVER a paragraph

type.exception: Does NOT apply to the YouTube thumbnail template in Brandkit/YouTube-Thumbnails/, which Ryan approved 2026-07-16 locked to its own stack. Leave that template alone.

logo.clearSpace: 8% of the placed logo height, all four sides
logo.status: STALE. Every current logo is built on the v1.0 teal and gold and is now off-palette. Clear-space and min-size rules below still hold and carry forward to whatever replaces them. Regeneration is open work.
